newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful quake shakes Colombia's Pacific coast.
newsitem.headline: Powerful quake shakes Colombia's Pacific coast.

text.p: A powerful earthquake measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale rocked a sparsely populated region on Colombia's Pacific coast on Wednesday, the National Seismological Institute said.
The epicentre was located near the town of Sipi, a jungle area in the foothills of the Andes mountains in western Choco province, a spokesman for the institute said.
The tremor, which orginated 60 miles (100 km) beneath the earth's surface, was felt in neighbouring Valle del Cauca province and central Caldas province.
A spokeswoman for the National Centre for Disaster Prevention said there were no reports of damage or injuries as a result of the quake.
